root_cause: The latest protected main had governance-only commits after the last successful Production Source Snapshot artifact, while the normal Netlify production promotion remained blocked by expired deploy authority. A fresh exact source artifact was therefore required for safe temporary deployment recovery.
prevention: Never reconstruct a production artifact from an older source marker without documenting the exact lineage.
When main advances after the last source snapshot, regenerate the canonical production-source artifact before any recovery deploy.
Operational workflow refreshes are material delivery and must include Brain learning, ledger and human documentation in the same lineage.
LIVE_BEWEZEN still requires provider success, exact release.json SHA/context/deploy-id and browser readback.
